1.explanation:
• Link/README.md contains the updated spec for the inline variant.
• Link/index.js is the React implementation where the variant is chosen.
• Link/_link.scss holds the CSS rules for underlines, colors, and pseudo-states.
• Link/__tests__/Link-test.js verifies state styling and can pinpoint regression.
• Link/Link.stories.js shows live examples across backgrounds—useful to reproduce and verify fixes.
1.bug_scenario: The screenshot shows the new “inline” link variant in its various pseudo-states (enabled, hover, active, focus, disabled, visited) rendered on four background colors (white, gray-10, gray-100, g100). The bug is that the underline and color styles specified in the spec (updated Aug 30) aren’t being applied consistently across those states and backgrounds—for example, the hover underline or the disabled color may be missing or wrong.
